description: This file defines the WordActivity class, an Android activity that displays a word and its definition, handles search integration, and navigates within the app.

classes.name: WordActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a word and its definition, supports search, and provides navigation capabilities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and populates UI elements with data fetched from a URI.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, sets up the SearchView for SDK versions >= Honeycomb.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, initiating search requests or navigating back to the main dictionary activity.
